paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance of two models, RECA and GAIT_GAT, across three distinct frequency categories—High, Medium, and Low—on the Semtab dataset. The vertical axis, labeled "Macro f-score," is scaled linearly from 0 to 1, with gridlines and tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1. The horizontal axis, labeled "Frequency," displays the three frequency categories in order from left to right: "High," "Medium," and "Low." For each frequency category, two adjacent bars are shown: a light peach-colored bar representing RECA and an orange-colored bar representing GAIT_GAT, as indicated by the legend below the chart. The specific macro f-scores are labeled directly on top of each bar: for the "High" frequency group, RECA achieves 0.837 and GAIT_GAT achieves 0.877; for the "Medium" frequency group, RECA achieves 0.538 and GAIT_GAT achieves 0.609; and for the "Low" frequency group, RECA achieves 0.114 and GAIT_GAT achieves 0.224. The bars are not sorted by value but are presented in the order of the frequency categories. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and direct numerical labeling.
